scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:browser
scripts.build:all: npm run build:extension && npm run build:browser && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:browser: npm rebuild drivelist && npm run bundle --workspace @bistable/theia-browser
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspace @bistable/theia-workbench && npm run clean --workspace @bistable/theia-electron
scripts.test: npm run build:extension && node scripts/check-shared-react.mjs && node scripts/check-live-reload.mjs && node scripts/check-problem-lifecycle.mjs && node scripts/check-rtl-schematic.mjs
